about: The advert square (7 October 2026, ruling 43). Off until Anthony switches it on: set enabled to true. Each advert: id, title, words, link (a page in the app or a full https address) and who it is from. Only adverts agreed and paid for, or our own (house adverts). Never alcohol, tobacco, gambling, medicines or payday loans; never flashing or moving; never on paying, card or checkout screens; never read aloud by Ozi unless asked. Ozi Plus members can hide it.
